command:
printf 'R110_UNAME='; uname -r; printf 'R110_BOOT_ID='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; r110_magic=$(devmem 0x50000058 64); printf 'R110_MAGIC=%s
' "$r110_magic"; case "$r110_magic" in 0x49444D414F425309|0x49444d414f425309) r110_oldidx=$(devmem 0x50000070 64); printf 'R110_OLD_INDEX=%s
' "$r110_oldidx"; for r110_word in 3872 3873 3874 3875 3876 3877; do devmem 0x50000070 64 $r110_word; printf 'R110_WORD_%s=' $r110_word; devmem 0x50000078 64; done; devmem 0x50000070 64 "$r110_oldidx"; printf 'R110_RESTORED_INDEX='; devmem 0x50000070 64;; *) printf 'R110_MODE_UNVERIFIED_BAD_MAGIC
';; esac; printf 'R110_MODE_QUERY_END
'
limits: TTY open/configuration can affect host modem state; no explicit DTR/RTS control. Only a framed software identity query; no proof of live BIT hash, mode, or physical clock.
